page.overview:
Who is Diva Arroquitas?

Diva Arroquitas was a female Theelin who was the master of ceremonies in the Priole Danna Festival on the planet Lamuir IV just one year before the Clone Wars began. The following year, Arroquitas refused to travel during the ongoing Separatist Crisis for the 2,345th festival, though its director Eizzam Stachrini insisted the festival would continue as scheduled. However, the festival ultimately was canceled due to security concerns.
